name: scroll-site-design
description: Design a new DesignAI site from a brief, from nothing, instead of adapting an example. Covers finding the story and the one idea, choosing scenes for what each moment must do (with at least one thing the visitor plays with), setting a look with art directions, writing specific copy and picture prompts, and checking the result is not a copy of an example. Use before writing or rewriting any site spec.
